pr_title: windows_firewall_rule: allow for multiple remote addresses
pr_body:
Updated the spec file to account for the change in data types

Signed-off-by: John McCrae <john.mccrae@progress.com>
pr_comments: Can we make sure to exercise this new functionality in the kitchen tests

issue_context.title: windows_firewall_rule support for multiple remote_address
issue_context.body:
### Describe the Enhancement:
Unable to list multiple destinations as parameter for remote_address

### Describe the Need:
Allow remote_address to accept list of destinations as array type parameter (similar to ports)

### Current Alternative
There is no good alternative, except either using powershell script resource directly or declaring resource multiple times
comments:
It looks like the New-NetFirewallRule supports arrays for remote_address like this:

New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "MyRule" -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 1434 -RemoteAddress @("10.17.3.101","172.7.7.53")

Can the windows_firewall_rule resource be updated to use that method?

review_comments: Because you coerce the state into an array you also want to coerce the inputs here. Otherwise if a person passes a single string value it won't match the current state value which would be the string in array form. Use coerce here to array and also sort it. Then you don't need to coerce and sort it later when you use it in the action.
